text: fuck. nevermind u gotta fix it cuz it has the image set in local store so going to the editor just crashes D:
resolution: Fixed the boot-loop crash: an <Image> source wider/taller than wgpu's maxTextureDimension2D (8192px) made wgpuDeviceCreateTexture raise an uncaptured error — a non-unwinding panic that SIGABRTed the whole app rather than returning null — so a 10240px trace reference dropped onto a paint surface killed the cart, and once that source was saved in localstore the editor crashed on every boot. framework/gpu/image_cache.zig load() now clamps to MAX_TEXTURE_DIM (8192) BEFORE any GPU work: if either axis exceeds the limit it bilinearly downscales the decoded RGBA to fit (aspect ratio preserved, a new resampleRgba helper, index math in usize so huge sources can't overflow u32, scratch buffer freed on return), then proceeds with the existing swizzle/flip/createTexture path on the smaller buffer. Images within the limit are untouched; the decode+resample runs once and is cached. Rebuilt ReleaseFast (SHIP_RUN_PACKAGE=0) green. The user must rebuild their dev host (framework change) to pick it up; the persisted oversized image will then load downscaled instead of aborting.
